title: Clara on night duty (paraphrase)
topic: A nurse named Clara works a quiet night shift in a hospital: an old man calls for water, a doctor checks the charts, the shift ends at seven

E.pred: gets him a cup of water

author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase of family F07
notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten F07A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Clara). Replacements include night shift/night duty (Nachtschicht/Nachtdienst), reads/studies (liest/studiert), duty room/ward office (Dienstzimmer/Stationszimmer), presses the call button/rings the bell (drückt den Rufknopf/betätigt die Klingel), brings a glass of water/fetches some water (bringt ein Glas Wasser/holt etwas Wasser), monitors/machines (Monitore/Geräte), doctor checks the charts/physician reviews the files (Arzt prüft die Krankenakten/Mediziner kontrolliert die Akten), changes a bandage/replaces a dressing (wechselt/erneuert einen Verband), night passes quietly on the ward/ward stays calm until the morning (Nacht vergeht ruhig/Station bleibt ruhig). 'übernimmt' (unit 1) and 'erneuert' (unit 7) are inseparable; no separable verbs are used. Present tense and positive polarity throughout.
